name: remote-publication
description: Publication of an approved squash commit to the registered GitHub base, with private prepared refs for retry and an optional human-selected major/minor tag and GitHub Release.
cardTemplate: Summarise the remote-publication domain: approved squash publication, prepared-ref recovery, remote divergence protection, and optional human-selected major/minor Release creation.
specRefs: remote-publication — reviewed main and human-selected Release publication
rationale: The same transaction owns recovery of the prepared squash, remote base/tag consistency, Release metadata, and local completion. Review admission and generic workspace primitives remain separate domains.
